Author: BlueWaveXIV
Name: AutoBuy
Description: Private Market Board helper that searches configured gear keywords and buys listings at or below a configurable gil cap.
Punchline: Buy underpriced gear sets from the Market Board.
Changelog: Added temporary read-only Market Board trace mode through /autobuy trace and the Trace market button. It logs Market Board UI visibility, item-search agent state, listing proxy state, and callbacks while the user manually searches and opens listings. It does not buy or confirm purchases.
